fixture: Unchanged left-neutral T1 setup, 1 s settling, fixed root, SDF, dt=.004 s; 0 to12 N linear ramp in3 s; force on actual cap at its center along current shaft.
law_swap: Swap only both click return laws: manifest stiffness/damping/target/force_limit and URDF passive damping, plus matching common physical evidence. All other records and geometry remain unchanged.
structure: Read native names/type/dof/qpos offset/parent/child/local positive X axis/limits and every link mass; preserve exact URDF joint fragments.

direct_drive.basis: Use the existing old-law stiffness/damping as an already documented large drive; numerical diagnostic only, not a new approved return law.

interpretation: Compare B against A and D against C for law effect; C against A and D against B for chain effect. Moving direct drive rules out a locked/missing click DOF. Factor causality does not automatically identify a lower-level solver mechanism. Only if evidence points to force-link transfer run the conditional cap versus click-child contrast.
stop: No production changes before confirmed root cause. If numerical changes are needed, propose and stop; no parameter search.
